Name: Item Value Zeroer
Author: Wolfcraft12
Description:
Item Value Zeroer changes how money-making works in Stardew Valley.

All items—crops, forage, fish, ores, monster loot, etc.—will sell for 0g.
The only exception is cooked food, which still sells for its normal price.
This makes cooking the only way to earn money, creating a unique challenge or realism mode.

Features
Crops, fish, ores, forage, monster loot, artisan goods - sell for 0g
Cooked dishes - retain normal sale value
Store prices (Pierre’s, Clint’s, Marnie’s, etc.) - unchanged
Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0+
